test_cluster_with_columns_basic: test the cluster WITH_COLUMNS optimization pass that merges independent with_columns calls into a single plan node
test_cluster_with_columns_disable: test disabling the cluster_with_columns optimization using pl.QueryOptFlags(cluster_with_columns=False) to keep separate WITH_COLUMNS nodes
test_cluster_with_columns_dependencies: test that the optimizer refuses to cluster with_columns calls when later expressions depend on previously computed columns
test_cluster_with_columns_prune: test the optimizer prunes unused columns and merges with_columns while preserving referenced columns in the final plan
test_cluster_with_columns_swap_remove: test the optimizer reorders and swaps with_columns expressions to cluster dependents of intermediate columns together
